parallels.note: Joshua spoke to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, saying,

people.name: Assyria
people.line: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.

people.name: Gozan
people.line: A region in Mesopotamia where Israelite captives were deported.

people.name: Habor
people.line: A river in Assyria where Israelite captives were settled.

people.name: Halah
people.line: A place where Israelites were exiled by the Assyrians.

people.name: Hara
people.line: A place where Israelite tribes were exiled by Tiglath-pileser.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

people.name: Reuben
people.line: Firstborn son of Jacob and Leah

people.name: Tiglath-pileser
people.line: Assyrian king who conquered parts of Israel

translations.web: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and to the river of Gozan, to this day.
translations.bsb: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria (that is, Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria) to take the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh into exile. And he brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and the river of Gozan, where they remain to this day.
translations.kjv: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, unto this day.
